package config_test

import (
	"os"
	"testing"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/config"
)

func TestConfigDefaultsPracticeServiceToRuntime(t *testing.T) {
	previous, wasSet := os.LookupEnv("PRACTICE_SERVICE_BASE_URL")
	require.NoError(t, os.Unsetenv("PRACTICE_SERVICE_BASE_URL"))
	t.Cleanup(func() {
		if wasSet {
			_ = os.Setenv("PRACTICE_SERVICE_BASE_URL", previous)
		} else {
			_ = os.Unsetenv("PRACTICE_SERVICE_BASE_URL")
		}
	})

	cfg, err := config.Load()
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "http://localhost:8080", cfg.PracticeServiceBaseURL)
}

func validConfig() config.Config {
	return config.Config{
		HTTPBindAddress:                   "127.0.0.1",
		HTTPPort:                          "8080",
		DatabaseURL:                       "postgres://database",
		NATSURL:                           "nats://broker:4222",
		ShutdownTimeout:                   10,
		OutboxPollIntervalMS:              500,
		OutboxBatchSize:                   50,
		OutboxLockTTLSeconds:              300,
		OutboxRetryBaseSeconds:            1,
		OutboxRetryMaxSeconds:             300,
		OutboxPublishTimeoutSeconds:       5,
		NATSConnectTimeoutSeconds:         2,
		StudentServiceBaseURL:             "http://student",
		StudentServiceInternalToken:       "student-token",
		StudentServiceTeacherToken:        "student-teacher-token",
		CourseServiceBaseURL:              "http://course",
		CourseServiceInternalToken:        "course-token",
		DialogServiceBaseURL:              "http://dialog",
		DialogServiceInternalToken:        "dialog-token",
		DialogSpaceKey:                    "platform",
		AIPromptServiceBaseURL:            "http://ai-prompt",
		AIPromptServiceInternalToken:      "ai-token",
		StatisticServiceBaseURL:           "http://statistic",
		StatisticServiceInternalToken:     "statistic-token",
		LearningPlannerBaseURL:            "http://learning-planner",
		LearningPlannerInternalToken:      "learning-planner-token",
		PracticeServiceBaseURL:            "http://practice",
		PracticeServiceInternalToken:      "practice-teacher-token",
		LearningPlannerTeacherToken:       "learning-planner-handoff-token",
		DependencyTimeoutSeconds:          3,
		OnboardingActionLeaseSeconds:      30,
		AIPromptTimeoutSeconds:            70,
		TeacherDialogWorkerPollIntervalMS: 250,
		TeacherDialogWorkerBatchSize:      10,
		TeacherDialogWorkerLeaseSeconds:   180,
		TeacherDialogWorkerConcurrency:    2,
		TeacherDialogLeaseRenewSeconds:    30,
		TeacherDialogMaxAttempts:          20,
		TeacherDialogRetryBaseSeconds:     1,
		TeacherDialogRetryMaxSeconds:      300,
		OnboardingHandoffPollIntervalMS:   250,
		OnboardingHandoffLeaseSeconds:     30,
		OnboardingHandoffRetryBaseSeconds: 1,
		OnboardingHandoffRetryMaxSeconds:  300,
		OnboardingHandoffMaxAttempts:      20,
	}
}

func TestConfigRequiresHTTPBindAddress(t *testing.T) {
	cfg := validConfig()
	cfg.HTTPBindAddress = ""
	require.ErrorContains(t, cfg.Validate(), "HTTP_BIND_ADDRESS")
}

func TestConfigKeepsPlannerHandoffDarkUntilAllS7Flags(t *testing.T) {
	cfg := validConfig()
	cfg.OnboardingPlannerHandoffEnabled = true
	require.ErrorContains(t, cfg.Validate(), "TEACHER_ONBOARDING_PLANNER_HANDOFF_ENABLED")
	cfg.ProductAwareOnboardingEnabled = true
	cfg.TeacherDialogDenseOrderingEnabled = true
	cfg.OnboardingCanonicalActionsEnabled = true
	cfg.UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled = true
	require.NoError(t, cfg.Validate())
	cfg.LearningPlannerTeacherToken = cfg.LearningPlannerInternalToken
	require.ErrorContains(t, cfg.Validate(), "LEARNING_PLANNER_TEACHER_TOKEN")
}

func TestConfigAllowsNoHandoffCredentialWhileS8IsDark(t *testing.T) {
	cfg := validConfig()
	cfg.LearningPlannerTeacherToken = ""
	require.NoError(t, cfg.Validate())

	cfg.OnboardingPlannerHandoffEnabled = true
	cfg.ProductAwareOnboardingEnabled = true
	cfg.TeacherDialogDenseOrderingEnabled = true
	cfg.OnboardingCanonicalActionsEnabled = true
	cfg.UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled = true
	require.ErrorContains(t, cfg.Validate(), "requires LEARNING_PLANNER_TEACHER_TOKEN")
}

func TestConfigRejectsSharedOptionalHandoffCredentialEvenWhileDark(t *testing.T) {
	cfg := validConfig()
	cfg.LearningPlannerTeacherToken = cfg.LearningPlannerInternalToken
	require.ErrorContains(t, cfg.Validate(), "must differ")
}

func TestConfigValidatesOutboxLeaseCoverage(t *testing.T) {
	cfg := validConfig()
	require.NoError(t, cfg.Validate())
	cfg.OutboxLockTTLSeconds = 250
	require.ErrorContains(t, cfg.Validate(), "cover")
}

func TestConfigRejectsMissingNATSURL(t *testing.T) {
	cfg := validConfig()
	cfg.NATSURL = ""
	require.Error(t, cfg.Validate())
}

func TestConfigValidatesTeacherDialogLeaseCoverage(t *testing.T) {
	cfg := validConfig()
	cfg.TeacherDialogWorkerLeaseSeconds = 2*cfg.AIPromptTimeoutSeconds + 4*cfg.DependencyTimeoutSeconds
	require.ErrorContains(t, cfg.Validate(), "TEACHER_DIALOG_WORKER_LEASE_SECONDS")
}

func TestConfigAcceptsLocalAIPromptTimingBudget(t *testing.T) {
	cfg := validConfig()
	cfg.AIPromptTimeoutSeconds = 135
	cfg.DependencyTimeoutSeconds = 3
	cfg.TeacherDialogWorkerLeaseSeconds = 300
	require.NoError(t, cfg.Validate())
}

func TestConfigRequiresDedicatedStudentTeacherToken(t *testing.T) {
	cfg := validConfig()
	cfg.StudentServiceTeacherToken = ""
	require.ErrorContains(t, cfg.Validate(), "URLs and tokens")

	cfg.StudentServiceTeacherToken = cfg.StudentServiceInternalToken
	require.ErrorContains(t, cfg.Validate(), "must differ")
}

func TestConfigKeepsCanonicalActionsDarkUntilUnifiedCoordinator(t *testing.T) {
	cfg := validConfig()
	cfg.OnboardingCanonicalActionsEnabled = true
	require.ErrorContains(t, cfg.Validate(), "TEACHER_UNIFIED_COORDINATOR_ENABLED")
	cfg.UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled = true
	require.ErrorContains(t, cfg.Validate(), "dense dialog ordering")
	cfg.TeacherDialogDenseOrderingEnabled = true
	require.NoError(t, cfg.Validate())
}

func TestConfigKeepsProductAwareOnboardingDarkUntilAllCoordinatorFlags(t *testing.T) {
	cfg := validConfig()
	cfg.ProductAwareOnboardingEnabled = true
	require.ErrorContains(t, cfg.Validate(), "TEACHER_PRODUCT_AWARE_ONBOARDING_ENABLED")
	cfg.TeacherDialogDenseOrderingEnabled = true
	cfg.OnboardingCanonicalActionsEnabled = true
	cfg.UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled = true
	require.NoError(t, cfg.Validate())
}

func TestConfigAllowsIndependentDefaultDarkNextBestAction(t *testing.T) {
	cfg := validConfig()
	require.False(t, cfg.NextBestActionEnabled)
	cfg.NextBestActionEnabled = true
	require.NoError(t, cfg.Validate())
}
